newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint ends steady vs basket in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint ends steady vs basket in slow trade.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed steady against the central bank's dollar/mark currency basket and finished a shade firmer against the dollar as the U.S. unit weakened versus the mark, dealers said.
The forint closed at 196.15/20 to the dollar, compared to 196.27 at opening.
The Hungarian currency remained at the central bank's resistance level in slow afternoon trading, said Attila Behan of ING Bank.
The forint floats within the National Bank of Hungary's 4.5 percent intervention range against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.
